the use of oral contraceptives by women of low socioeconomic status leads to a fall in folate levels, which may be associated with an increase in the risk of neural-tube defects in their offspring.

the effect of oral contraceptive treatment (OCT) on serum folate concentrations in rural Sri Lankan (Ceylon) women.
the study of the effects of the oral contraceptive Ovulen 50 on serum folate concentrations of women of different economic status.
